fields.label: Thank-you message
fields.sample:
Thank you endlessly for being with us on this journey, for sharing our joy and for making this day unforgettable for us.
We're so lucky to have you; here's to meeting again on many more happy days.

elements.name: Künye bandı yazısı
elements.text: Interview special  ·  Bride and groom speak for the first time  ·  Q&A

elements.name: Spot
elements.text: The most candid pre-wedding interview: first impressions, the night of the proposal and the still-unresolved coffee turn.

elements.name: Kapak altyazısı
elements.text: For the interview, the couple posed for our cameras at the café across from the bookshop where it all began.

elements.name: Haber başlığı
elements.text: The stars of a story that began in a bookshop seven years ago speak for the first time

elements.name: Haber metni
elements.text:
KADIKÖY (Go Post) – For years we had heard, through the grapevine, the story of two hands reach­ing for the same book at the same moment. Vis­it­ing our paper ahead of the wed­ding, the couple told it all in their own words for the first time: their first im­pres­sions, the night of the pro­pos­al and the coffee-turn ques­tion that has gone un­re­solved for seven years.
The in­ter­view took place in a small café right across from the book­shop where it all began. Over three hours of con­ver­sa­tion, six cups of coffee were drunk and the recorder was stopped twice be­cause of laugh­ter. The bride start­ed every answer with “just a minute”; the groom wrapped up most of his with a joke.
You'll find the full in­ter­view, the quick-fire ques­tions and the couple's final word to our read­ers on the inside pages.

elements.name: Satır başı cevap
elements.text: “We reached for the same book at once.”

elements.name: Satır başı cevap
elements.text: “With a ring hidden between the pages of a novel.”

elements.name: Satır başı cevap
elements.text: “Whose turn it is to make coffee. Still ongoing.”

elements.name: Kutu metni
elements.text: Got a question of your own? Ask us at the wedding: answers from both of us, coffee on us.

elements.name: Spot
elements.text: Our paper's toughest interview yet: two people, one microphone and laughter that never ended.

elements.name: İmza
elements.text: Interview: Go Post editorial team  ·  Photos: Go Post archive

elements.name: Fotoğraf altyazısı
elements.text: The laughter never stopped during the interview; the recorder had to be paused twice.

elements.name: Giriş
elements.text: It was the toughest interview our paper has ever done: two people, one microphone and laughter that never ended. We met at the little café across from the bookshop where it all began. The coffee went cold, the questions ran long; the answers always led to the same place.

elements.name: Cevap
elements.text: In a small book­shop in Kadıköy. We reached for the same book at the same time. I said, “you take it,” and he said, “no, you reached first.” The book­sell­er looked at us both pa­tient­ly.

elements.name: Cevap
elements.text: In the end, one of us kept the book and the other the phone number. We've spent seven years de­bat­ing which was the better deal; no winner yet.

elements.name: Cevap
elements.text: Hon­est­ly? I thought, “he talks a lot.” Then I re­al­ized I loved lis­ten­ing to him. He still talks a lot, and I'm still lis­ten­ing.

elements.name: Cevap
elements.text: “She has a beau­ti­ful laugh.” Seven years later, I haven't changed my mind. I keep telling bad jokes to make her laugh; it works.

elements.name: Soru
elements.text: How did the first date go?

elements.name: Cevap
elements.text: It was sup­posed to be one coffee, and we ended up at dinner. Then we walked to the shore; the tea was re­filled three times, and the waiter waited until morn­ing to clear the table.

elements.name: Cevap
elements.text: The next morn­ing he sent the first text: “How's the book going?” I hadn't even opened it. I read it in one sit­ting that day so we'd have some­thing to talk about.

elements.name: Cevap
elements.text: Out­side the same book­shop, with a ring hidden be­tween the pages of a novel. The book­sell­er was in on it; we had ar­ranged the shelves two days in ad­vance.

elements.name: Cevap
elements.text: I didn't need to finish the book to answer. But I fin­ished it later anyway; the ending was beau­ti­ful, just like ours.

elements.name: Alıntı
elements.text: “One hits the brakes, the other the gas; the middle suits us perfectly.”

elements.name: Soru
elements.text: Your favorite thing about each other?

elements.name: Cevap
elements.text: His pa­tience. I want ev­ery­thing right away; he says “just a minute.” That one minute usu­al­ly saves us.

elements.name: Cevap
elements.text: Her cheer­ful­ness. I'm slow; she speeds things up. One hits the brakes, the other the gas; the middle suits us per­fect­ly.

elements.name: Cevap
elements.text: Whose turn it is to make coffee. It's been going on for seven years, and ac­cord­ing to the records, I'm not ahead.

elements.name: Cevap
elements.text: A ref­er­ee will be ap­point­ed after the wed­ding. Our moth­ers are among the can­di­dates; both claim to be neu­tral.

elements.name: Soru
elements.text: What awaits us at the wedding?

elements.name: Cevap
elements.text: A sunset cer­e­mo­ny, dinner at long tables and a dance floor that will go until dawn. We made the playlist to­geth­er; with­out a single fight, be­lieve it or not.

elements.name: Cevap
elements.text: Bring com­fort­able shoes. That's not a sug­ges­tion, it's a re­quest. The bride will per­son­al­ly pull seated guests onto the floor.

elements.name: Soru
elements.text: What was the hardest part of the preparations?

elements.name: Cevap
elements.text: The seat­ing plan. Two fam­i­lies, three groups of friends and a cat… The cat isn't coming to the wed­ding, but its name is on the plan; nobody wanted to take its seat.

elements.name: Cevap
elements.text: The playlist. We both had to ap­prove every song, so it took two months. The result: a night ev­ery­one will dance through.

elements.name: Cevap
elements.text: It's a secret. All we can say is that we packed more books than clothes. Who pays the excess bag­gage fee is an­oth­er debate en­tire­ly.

elements.name: Cevap
elements.text: We also bought a map. This time we're de­ter­mined not to get lost; but if we do, that's fine too. It hap­pened on our first va­ca­tion as well.

elements.name: Soru
elements.text: Finally, what would you like to tell our readers?

elements.name: Cevap
elements.text: Be by our side that day. We've writ­ten the story up to here; we want to write the rest with you.

elements.name: Spot
elements.text: No thinking, at the same time: the bride and groom answered the same questions separately.

elements.name: Fotoğraf altyazısı
elements.text: Answers taken separately, no copying. The laughs were shared.

elements.name: Gelin cevabı
elements.text: …in the same bookshop, hand in hand.

elements.name: Damat cevabı
elements.text: …the first trip where we got lost.

elements.name: Katılım metni
elements.text: The last question is ours: Are you coming? Please let us know two weeks in advance.

elements.name: Kulis
elements.text: The quick-fire round had two rules: answer with­out think­ing, and no peek­ing at each other's paper. The first rule was never broken; we can't vouch for the second. On “Who's more ro­man­tic?”, both picked them­selves; our ed­i­tors called it a tie.

elements.name: Fotoğraf altyazısı
elements.text: The interview is over, the coffee has gone cold; the story is just beginning.

elements.name: Son söz
elements.text: The best answer in this interview: you, by our side that day.

elements.name: Kutu metni
elements.text: First anniversary interview: same table, same coffee, brand-new questions.

elements.name: Bölüm Okurlarımızdan sorular, çiftten cevaplar
elements.text: Questions from our readers, answers from the couple

elements.name: Okur sorusu
elements.text: — Is there chocolate in the cake?

elements.name: Çiftin cevabı
elements.text: There is. As for the number of tiers, you'll find out on the wed­ding day; our baker has sworn to se­cre­cy.

elements.name: Çiftin cevabı
elements.text: Of course. We've pre­pared crayons, sto­ry­books and a huge play corner for our little guests.

elements.name: Çiftin cevabı
elements.text: Smart and com­fort­able. Any­thing you can dance in works; for the garden, we rec­om­mend wedge heels.

elements.name: Çiftin cevabı
elements.text: The best gift is having you with us that day. Any­thing else is just a lovely extra.

elements.name: Çiftin cevabı
elements.text: Phones in pock­ets during the cer­e­mo­ny, please. After that, snap away; share your best shots with us.

elements.name: Çiftin cevabı
elements.text: The shut­tle leaves Beşik­taş at 15:30. Park­ing is lim­it­ed, so the shut­tle or a taxi is the eas­i­est option.

elements.name: Çiftin cevabı
elements.text: Ev­ery­one named on the in­vi­ta­tion. We ask so no one is left out when we count tables.

elements.name: Çiftin cevabı
elements.text: When the last song plays. Nobody knows the time; hon­est­ly, nei­ther do we, but it won't be early.

elements.name: Editörün notu
elements.text: We laughed a lot putting this interview together; we had to stop the recorder several times. Most of our questions got two different answers, but the last one had just one. Keep this paper: when you read it years from now, you'll hear the laughter at that table all over again.

elements.name: Kulis maddesi
elements.text: The bride remembered every coffee drunk.

elements.name: Kulis maddesi
elements.text: The bookseller waved from the window.

values.thanks:
Thank you endlessly for being with us on this journey, for sharing our joy and for making this day unforgettable for us.
We're so lucky to have you; here's to meeting again on many more happy days.
